intro: Misha Tor'kren is an orc mother dwelling at the Tor'kren Farm in western Durotar, southeast of Thunder Ridge. Plagued by anxiety over her missing son Kron, she appeals to passing travelers for aid in discovering his fate.

p: Tucked away near the edge of Thunder Ridge, Misha Tor'kren works her isolated farmstead while enduring a parent's worst fear. Her son Kron ventured west toward the Southfury River to hunt crocolisks and prove his mettle, but he never returned. With Durotar's frontier dangers stretching orcish watchtowers thin, Misha is left alone to hope for word of his whereabouts, desperate for anyone willing to search the riverbanks for signs of her boy.
